title: ULA Vulcan Rocket Fails and Destroys 40 Amazon Satellites
excerpt: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket suffered its first mission failure, destroying 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites.
body_html:
United Launch Alliance (ULA) experienced what is reported to be its first mission failure in its twenty-year history. The incident occurred when a Vulcan rocket failed to deliver its payload to orbit.

The launch carried forty satellites for Amazon's Leo network, which is designed to compete with SpaceX's Starlink. The destruction of these satellites deals a setback to Amazon's constellation project, which has faced struggles getting off the ground and has only deployed a small portion of the satellites required to challenge its competitor.
